six_main_adjudications.title: Opening previews are useful bounded windows, not premature period clips
six_main_adjudications.evidence_summary: In v1, _opening() used a regex stopping at the first '.!?' and claimed partial_sentence=False, producing 33,441 opening previews <= 30 chars (and 22,942 <= 15 chars) with > 20 chars of remaining unit text and 110,088 openings with < 100 non-placeholder chars in units >= 120 non-placeholder chars. In v3, _opening() delegates to _safe_window(..., max_chars=240), reducing short openings <= 30 chars with more text from 33,441 -> 0 (and <= 15 chars from 22,942 -> 0), and reducing < 100 clean-char openings in >= 120 clean-char units from 110,088 -> 6 (all 6 are placeholder-dense units whose raw preview is 235-238 chars).

six_main_adjudications.title: Opening previews skip placeholder/punctuation-only prefix lines when alphanumeric text exists
six_main_adjudications.evidence_summary: In v1, _content_start() only checked not line.isspace(), causing 1,520 opening previews to begin on lines containing only <FRAGMENT_SUPPRESSED>/<REFERENCE_SUPPRESSED> plus punctuation or separator dots. In v3, _content_start() requires any(ch.isalnum() for ch in PLACEHOLDER.sub('', value)), reducing opening_starts_on_placeholder_punct_line from 1,520 -> 0 across all 381,959 opening previews: 1,193 units advanced to the first real alphanumeric line and 327 units with zero alphanumeric content outside markers/placeholders ceased emitting an opening preview (115 with placeholder anchors kept a clean anchor preview; 212 without anchors moved to preview_refs=[] with preview_absence_reason='no_meaningful_opening_or_anchor').

six_main_adjudications.title: Preview deduplication and Slot 2 novel anchor coverage selection
six_main_adjudications.evidence_summary: In v1, _add_window() only checked one-way containment (a <= left and right <= b) after inserting the anchor window first, resulting in 20,147 contained duplicate preview pairs, 11,181 overlaps reaching before content_start into [N] markers, and 14,154 multi-anchor units where 2 overlapping previews covered only 1 anchor. In v3, bidirectional containment and merge-within-240 (when min(a, left) >= content_start) reduce contained pairs from 20,147 -> 0, mergeable <=240 overlaps from 20,147 -> 0, and pre-content_start overlaps from 11,181 -> 0. Slot 2 deterministic novel coverage selection increases units with >=2 anchors displaying >=2 anchors from 23,933/43,383 (55.17%) to 37,827/43,383 (87.19%) and total displayed unit anchors from 141,352 (138,148 full) to 169,166 (168,652 full).

six_main_adjudications.title: Word and protected-tag boundary safety (including v2 -> v3 9-case tag-clip regression fix)
six_main_adjudications.evidence_summary: In v1, raw character slicing produced 68,754 mid-word clips and 3,367 mid-tag clips (e.g. '<FRAGMENT_S' or '<'). In v2, _safe_window() respected word and PROTECTED_TAG boundaries except when tail candidates passed a pre-clipped span (max(a, b - max_chars), b) into _safe_window, leaving 245 mid-word clips and 9 mid-tag clips. In v3, tail candidates pass the full original cue span (a, b) into _safe_window, reducing word_clipped_raw from 68,754 (v1) / 245 (v2) -> 0 (v3) and tag_clipped_raw from 3,367 (v1) / 9 (v2) -> 0 (v3) across all 454,275 previews. Furthermore, synthetic fallback testing on >240-char unbroken tokens/tags confirmed that word_boundary_clipped and tag_boundary_clipped flip to True and are accepted by validate_case when a single token/tag exceeds 240 chars.

six_main_adjudications.title: Honest clipping/sentence metadata and units without preview
six_main_adjudications.evidence_summary: Across all 454,275 previews in v3, partial_sentence is None (0 false completeness claims), boundary_status is 'content_window_not_sentence_verified', and start_clipped, end_clipped, truncated match independent character-offset checks against [baseline, content_end] with 0 mismatches. All 267 units without preview (55 from v1 + 212 that had punctuation/placeholder-only previews in v1) were verified to have content_start is None (zero alphanumeric characters outside markers/placeholders) and 0 anchors, while preserving handles, byte spans, neighbor links, and open_context access.

six_main_adjudications.title: Provenance, seal, tamper resistance, and non-preview invariance
six_main_adjudications.evidence_summary: All 7,708 case sidecars, source_registry.json, summary.json, manifest.json, and seal.json in v3 verified against raw bytes, M0 (m0_20261105_v2), M1 (m1_20261105_v2), and v1 (m2_navigation_20261105_v1). Across all 7,708 cases: 216,946 unit anchors, 1,237 source anchors, 48,990 headings, and all 382,343 navigation rows (excluding preview_refs and preview_absence_reason) are 100% identical between v1 and v3. Isolated tamper tests confirmed that NavigationReader rejects raw byte tamper (even after resealing), M1 structure tamper (even after resealing), and preview/anchor offset tamper (even after resealing).

documented_non_blocking_limitations.description: Preview windows are bounded to 240 Unicode codepoints and at most 2 previews per unit. In 6 units across the corpus (007777/u000001, 014803/u000001, 016528/u000001, 028057/p000045, 040347/u000001, 081901/u000001), repeated <FRAGMENT_SUPPRESSED> tags inside the 235-238 char opening window leave 88-91 non-placeholder characters. Similarly, quote cues longer than 240 chars are marked fully_visible=False, source_cue_fully_visible=False, visibility='partial', and units with >2 anchors (or 2,370 units where a long cue's head and tail occupy both slots) cannot display every anchor inline in map.
documented_non_blocking_limitations.mitigation: Map explicitly exposes anchor_count, anchor_visibility, start_clipped, end_clipped, and truncated; full unit anchors and source quote cues are retrievable via NavigationReader.anchors() / source_anchors() and raw text via open_context().

documented_non_blocking_limitations.description: 267 navigation units have preview_refs=[] and preview_absence_reason='no_meaningful_opening_or_anchor' because their raw text contains zero alphanumeric characters outside [N] markers and suppression placeholders (e.g. '[2]', ':', '.....', '[21]\r\n[...]\r\n[...].') and zero anchors.
documented_non_blocking_limitations.mitigation: All 267 units retain handles, byte spans, neighbor links, and full raw expansion via NavigationReader.open_context().

documented_non_blocking_limitations.description: M2 is a deterministic navigation and preview layer, not a semantic parser or chunker: paragraph_role remains 'unknown' with uncertainties=['paragraph_ownership_unresolved'], partial_sentence is None ('content_window_not_sentence_verified'), and readiness marks token_counts='not_ready' and token_validated_chunks='not_ready'.
documented_non_blocking_limitations.mitigation: Preserved as explicit machine-readable flags so downstream stages and agents do not assume unverified semantics.
